records.title: Concern over status of implementation of Bodoland Peace Accord 2020.
details:
Shri Pramod Boro:
The Bodoland Territorial Region (BTR) has witnessed a
remarkable transformation since the signing of the Bodo Peace Accord 2020,
which has played a vital role in restoring peace, stability, and democratic
governance in the region after decades of unrest. The Accord has created an
enabling environment for development, strengthened the democratic aspirations
of the people, and fostered greater trust among stakeholders. Considerable
progress has been achieved in infrastructure development, education, livelihood
generation, and institutional strengthening, reflecting the positive impact of
the Accord. However, despite these achievements, several important commitments
envisaged under the Accord remain pending. These include constitutional,
administrative, financial, developmental, rehabilitation, and institutional
provisions that are crucial for the complete realization of its objectives. The
timely implementation of these commitments is essential to uphold the
assurances extended by the Government, sustain public confidence, reinforce the
peace process, promote inclusive development, and ensure long-term
socio-economic progress across the region. In view of the above, I request the
Government to provide a comprehensive update on the measures taken to fulfil its
various provisions. I also urge the Government to expedite the implementation
of all pending commitments in a time-bound manner. Such action will reinforce
the spirit and intent of this historic Accord, consolidate the gains of peace,
and fulfil the long-cherished aspirations of the people of the Bodoland
Territorial Region.
(ENDS)
